topic: Release and testing of analytics reports
summary_markdown:
The team discussed the release of analytics reports, including frequency and campaign data. The initial plan was to deploy to a beta environment for internal review before potentially moving to production later that evening.

[me] confirmed that their development work was ready for release in the dev environment. A key point of discussion was ensuring impressions were correctly included in the report/traffic dashboard, which [p6] noted needed verification.

The reports were successfully deployed to beta, allowing the team to begin internal testing and prepare for client launch.
decisions: The analytics feature will be released first to a beta environment for internal review.
The feature was subsequently deployed to beta, clearing the way for client launches.
